blocks.text: 🪝 DoP & TRAI Sign MoU for Village-Level Telecom Survey Across 5.68 Lakh Villages. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Department of Posts uses nationwide postal network to conduct India's largest rural telecom audit.
Audit Scale: Field survey assessing mobile network performance of Airtel, Jio, Vi, and BSNL across 5.68 lakh villages.
Execution Mechanism: Department of Posts conducts field operations; TRAI provides survey app and technical monitoring.
Survey village coverage (5.68 lakh villages) vs executing agency (Department of Posts).
